summary: Quote on an NSE equity: a 1501-json-full event, its quote nested in Touchline as XTS sends it, becomes a Quote frame with every quote field.

notes: The payload is the JSON string XTS puts in the event (tests/fixtures/brokers/fivepaisaxts/stream.json quote_1501).

deviations.reason: The web sends XTS's LastTradedTime as it comes, seconds since 1980-01-01 IST (1478686530 is 2026-11-09 10:15:30 IST); feed timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it (1794199530000).

This web adapter puts the mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends its label (ltp, quote, full). data.mode follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): closed in phase B by the broker's entry in lane wire's per-broker dialect switch.
